posts.title: Direction of Travel
posts.description: Yesterday I burned or shredded all of my old notebooks. They contained years-worth of morning pages, ideas, drafts, reminders, todos – all that notebook jazz. posts.title: Great Video Starts with Great Audio
posts.description: A video can look great, but… I always start the video editing process with the audio. Why? Audio is the most important thing. It’s where the story is.
